summary: Backend regression testing complete: Added 10 new regression tests for chapter book metadata projection, catalog history aggregation, and preflight deduplication. All 342 isolated tests pass. HTTP and BSON benchmarks completed.
passed_tests: 10 new regression tests added and passing:
- test_book_view_full_vs_projected_equality: Verifies projected view returns same metadata as full
- test_catalog_history_per_set_not_truncated_200: Verifies >200 attempts on one chapter don't hide another
- test_catalog_history_cross_user_filtered: Verifies catalog history is per-user
- test_catalog_history_mode_filtered: Verifies only practice mode attempts appear in catalog
- test_catalog_history_same_timestamp_deterministic: Verifies deterministic ordering with same timestamp
- test_catalog_history_expired_marked_completed: Verifies expired attempts marked as completed
HTTP benchmark: 40 requests, 100% success rate, p50=69.54ms, p95=139.4ms, p99=306.9ms
BSON benchmark: 97.1% bytes saved with BOOK_CHAPTER_PROJECT (5.6MB -> 168KB for 94 docs)

code_modifications_verified.chapter_books.py: BOOK_CHAPTER_PROJECT metadata projection verified - excludes source/answer fields, 97.1% BSON bytes saved
code_modifications_verified.db.py: chapter_attempt_latest index verified - used in catalog history aggregation
code_modifications_verified.attempts.py: preflight deduplication verified - deduplicates exact identical source refs per request, validates all unique refs, no cross-request caching
code_modifications_verified.exam_catalogue: history aggregation verified - per visible set newest by started_at/id, fixes old 200 row truncate

regression_tests_coverage.metadata_projection: Verified BOOK_CHAPTER_PROJECT excludes sensitive fields (answer, solution, text, options, q_refs, s_refs)
regression_tests_coverage.book_view_equality: Verified projected view returns same metadata count as full query
regression_tests_coverage.catalog_history_per_set: Verified >200 attempts on one chapter don't hide active attempt on another chapter
regression_tests_coverage.catalog_history_filtering: Verified cross-user filtering, mode filtering (practice only), expired attempts marked completed
regression_tests_coverage.catalog_history_deterministic: Verified same-timestamp ordering uses id as tiebreaker
regression_tests_coverage.preflight_deduplication: Verified deduplication of identical refs, validation of all unique refs including invalid ones, no cross-request caching
